info.title: e-qanun MCP (Azerbaijan legislation)
info.description: No-auth MCP server over Azerbaijan's official legal-acts database (api.e-qanun.az). Tools: search_acts (type filter supported), count_acts, get_act, get_act_fulltext (full text, paginated), list_types, list_sections. Use as a Copilot Studio custom MCP connector. NOTE: `host` below is a placeholder — replace it with your own public HTTPS host (the machine running `server.py --transport http`) before importing.
